name: IOIPG
recent: IOI Properties 完成收购新加坡 Shenton 101，并公布 2027 财年首季业绩：营收同比增 16% 至 RM1.13 bil，净利同比跌 8% 至 RM609 mil，主因上年同期有 RM503 mil 新加坡资产纸面收益。董事与主要股东在闭市期内外持续增持。
notable: 完成收购新加坡 Shenton 101 Pte. Ltd.，并支付股东垫款偿还额 SGD217.32 mil。
公布 2027 财年首季业绩，营收 RM1.13 bil，净利 RM609 mil。
董事 Dato' Lee Yeow Chor 与集团 CEO Dato' Lee Yeow Seng 在公开市场增持公司股份。
risks: 首季净利同比下滑 8%，因上年同期包含 RM503 mil 新加坡资产纸面收益。
公司有多项 MULTIPLE PROPOSALS 公告，具体内容未在资料中详述。
earnings: 2026 财年末季（截至 6 月 30 日）营收 RM1.387 bil，环比增 32.4%，同比增 55.8%；净利 RM523 mil，环比增 102.7%，同比减 36.5%；净利率 37.7%，高于上季的 24.6%。

recent_en: IOI Properties completed the acquisition of Shenton 101 in Singapore and reported 1QFY2027 results: revenue rose 16% YoY to RM1.13 bil while net profit fell 8% YoY to RM609 mil, mainly due to the absence of a RM503 mil paper gain on a Singapore asset in the prior-year quarter. Directors and major shareholders continued to acquire shares during and around the closed period.
notable_en: Completed the acquisition of Shenton 101 Pte. Ltd. in Singapore and paid shareholder advances repayment of SGD217.32 mil.
Announced 1QFY2027 results with revenue of RM1.13 bil and net profit of RM609 mil.
Director Dato' Lee Yeow Chor and Group CEO Dato' Lee Yeow Seng acquired shares in the open market.
risks_en: 1Q net profit fell 8% YoY as the prior-year quarter included a RM503 mil paper gain on a Singapore asset.
The company issued several MULTIPLE PROPOSALS announcements whose details are not specified in the provided materials.
earnings_en: For the final quarter of FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM1.387 bil, up 32.4% QoQ and 55.8% YoY; net profit was RM523 mil, up 102.7% QoQ but down 36.5% YoY; net margin was 37.7% versus 24.6% in the previous quarter.
